capabilities: Build pivot tables from Markdown tables with a drag-and-drop field list
Filter, sort and group pivot data with subtotals and grand totals
Render pivots as column, bar, line, pie or doughnut charts
Store pivot layouts as readable plain-text blocks that can be hand-edited
Reference source tables from other notes via block ids
extras: README lists planned features not yet included (date grouping, calculated fields, tabular layout, values on rows) and asks for donations to support development.
problem: Obsidian can display Markdown tables but offers no way to summarize, aggregate or chart their data interactively.

relations.evidence: a field list that works like the one in Excel

summary: Pivot table builder that turns Markdown tables into interactive pivot reports with a drag-and-drop field list, filters, grouping, totals and charts.
